description:
Title: Storage management

First, the order is read from the automatic order management system.
Then, it's checked if the first product from the order is in stock.
If it's in stock then it's withdrawn from the warehouse.
However, if it's not in stock then it's reordered from the wholesaler.
Note, that if it was necessary to wait more then 10 days for the arrival of the  product then a delivery delay penalty is automatically demanded from the wholesaler.
After the ordered product has arrived it's registered in the stock management system.
Finally, it's checked if the whole order is ready for shipment.
If the order is ready for shipment, a courier is requested and the products are packed simultaneously and finally shipped.
If it isn't then the next product from the order is selected and the process starts again with checking if this order is in stock or not.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_StorageManagement" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/storage-management">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProductArrived" name="Ordered product arrived"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Started" name="Storage management started"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadOrder" name="Read order from automatic order management system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFirstProduct" name="Select first product from order"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ProductMerge" name="Product to check"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockCheck" name="Is product in stock?" default="Flow_StockNo"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Withdraw" name="Withdraw product from warehouse"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Reorder" name="Reorder product from wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ProductArrived" name="Ordered product arrived">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_ProductArrived" messageRef="Message_ProductArrived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DelayCheck" name="Waited more than 10 days?" default="Flow_DelayNo"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_DemandPenalty" name="Automatically demand delivery delay penalty from wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DelayMerge" name="Delay check merge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterStock" name="Register product in stock management system"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AvailabilityMerge" name="Product available in warehouse"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckOrderReady" name="Check whether whole order is ready for shipment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReadyCheck" name="Is order ready for shipment?" default="Flow_NotReady"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipmentFork" name="Start courier and packing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestCourier" name="Request courier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackProducts" name="Pack products"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipmentJoin" name="Courier requested and products packed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShipOrder" name="Ship order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectNextProduct" name="Select next product from order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderShipped" name="Order shipped"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToRead" sourceRef="StartEvent_Started" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadToSelectFirst" sourceRef="Task_ReadOrder" targetRef="Task_SelectFirstProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectFirstToMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectFirstProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ProductMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToStockCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductMerge" targetRef="Gateway_StockCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_StockCheck" targetRef="Task_Withdraw">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${productInStock == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_StockCheck" targetRef="Task_Reorder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WithdrawToAvailability" sourceRef="Task_Withdraw" targetRef="Gateway_AvailabilityMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReorderToArrival" sourceRef="Task_Reorder" targetRef="Event_ProductArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArrivalToDelayCheck" sourceRef="Event_ProductArrived" targetRef="Gateway_DelayCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DelayYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_DelayCheck" targetRef="Task_DemandPenalty">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${waitingDays > 10}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DelayNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_DelayCheck" targetRef="Gateway_DelayMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PenaltyToDelayMerge" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Gateway_DelayMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DelayMergeToRegister" sourceRef="Gateway_DelayMerge" targetRef="Task_RegisterStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisterToAvailability" sourceRef="Task_RegisterStock" targetRef="Gateway_AvailabilityMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AvailabilityToCheckOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_AvailabilityMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckOrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckOrderToReadyCheck" sourceRef="Task_CheckOrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_ReadyCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadyYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ReadyCheck" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentFork">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${orderReady == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotReady" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ReadyCheck" targetRef="Task_SelectNextProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ForkToCourier" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentFork" targetRef="Task_RequestCourier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ForkToPack" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentFork" targetRef="Task_PackProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CourierToJoin" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackToJoin" sourceRef="Task_PackProducts" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToShip" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin" targetRef="Task_ShipOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShipToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ShipOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderShipped"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextProductToMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectNextProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ProductMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:definitions/>
</bpmn:definitions>
